title: Surreal Cosmic Stairway
description: A surreal painting on a black background features a large cracked red moon with purple flowers and dripping red liquid. A white line-drawn astronaut with a backpack reaches toward the moon while a blue patterned figure with three eyes on its head crouches on geometric stairs, holding a glowing orb surrounded by butterflies.
